title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
Paid Ads Specialist - Performance Marketing
Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Paid Ads Specialist to manage and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads .
This is a hands-on role focused on lead generation, conversions, ROAS, CPA, and scalable growth . You’ll own campaigns from setup and targeting through testing, optimization, tracking, and reporting.
We’re looking for someone who understands the numbers behind paid media and knows how to turn campaign data into better performance.
What You’ll Do
Paid Media Management

• Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google, Facebook/Instagram, and LinkedIn

• Conduct keyword, audience, competitor, and targeting research

• Manage campaign budgets and allocate spend based on performance

• Use campaign types such as Search, Display, Performance Max, remarketing, and paid social

Campaign Optimization

• Monitor and optimize ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, and lead volume

• Run structured A/B tests across:

• Ad copy and creative

• Audiences and targeting

• Landing pages

• Bidding strategies

• Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements

• Scale winning campaigns while maintaining efficiency

Tracking & Analytics

• Configure and monitor conversion tracking using Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager

• Analyze performance across the full acquisition funnel

• Prepare clear weekly/monthly performance reports

• Translate campaign data into actionable recommendations

Creative & Funnel Collaboration

• Work with design and content teams on ad creative and messaging

• Recommend landing page and funnel improvements

• Align paid acquisition campaigns with broader marketing goals

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads

• Strong understanding of PPC, paid social, conversion tracking, attribution, and remarketing

• Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

• Strong understanding of metrics including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rate

• Experience managing and optimizing advertising budgets

• Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

• Excellent communication and organization

• Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience with LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, or TikTok Ads

• Landing page and conversion rate optimization experience

• Experience with Performance Max, automation, scripts, and dynamic campaigns

• Multi-touch attribution knowledge

• Experience scaling successful lead-generation campaigns

What Success Looks Like

• Improved ROAS and CPA

• Consistent growth in qualified leads and conversions

• Efficient allocation of advertising budgets

• Accurate conversion tracking and reporting

• Strong testing cadence and continuous campaign improvement

• Clear, actionable performance insights

Why Join?

• Fully remote

• High ownership over paid acquisition

• Direct impact on leads, revenue, and growth

• Opportunity to manage campaigns across multiple advertising platforms

• Data-driven environment where testing and experimentation are encouraged

• Growth opportunities within Performance Marketing and Growth Marketing

Interview Process

• Application Review

• Spark Hire Intro Video

• Paid Media / Performance Marketing Interview

• Practical Campaign Exercise

• Client Interview

• Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply
Qualified applicants will receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to complete a short Intro Video. This helps us learn more about your paid advertising experience, communication skills, campaign management background, and approach to performance optimization .
Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the invitation.
Apply Now

description:

FEDSIM Senior Slide Architect/Book Boss Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!
Why Join Us?

•
Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

•
Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

•
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

If you naturally visualize story lines and prefer to organize complex information into a dynamic format, KBR Mission Technology Solutions (MTS) is seeking Visual Solution Designer to join a team dedicated to pursuing assisted acquisitions and strategic contracts. The work combines a need for clear strategic thinking, project management skills, and a passion for compelling and persuasive graphics-oriented communication. Though the position is remote, you will be an integral part of a collaborative pursuit team focused on winning new work.
Key Responsibilities:
The position supports the development of strategic and FEDSIM proposals as an oral presentation architect and content contributor. We are looking for an integral team player who works collaboratively with others, but who can also work independently, coordinate projects, develop and learn new skills, and maintain communication with various stakeholders across the enterprise. As a senior level position, responsibilities include mentoring more junior team members to help develop them into strong graphical business development contributors.
The primary responsibilities encompass project management and content development activities, sales material development and finalization, knowledge management, and research and analysis. You will:

• Support pursuit management team from opportunity identification through award

• Collaborate with Capture and Solution Architect team members to fully understand client desires and requirements

• Support development of solutions targeted to deliver against client desires and requirements

• Translate solution concepts into compelling graphics and slides

• Deeply understand complex technical material, narratives, and storyboards, and translate them into clear, accurate, and structured slide content

• Engage with dense subject matter and produce high‑quality, visually compelling, content‑rich presentations that effectively communicate key messages

• Develop proposal content for technical, management, and scenario responses

• Collaborate with authors of other proposal sections to maintain message alignment across all proposal sections and volumes

• Apply FEDSIM-specific oral proposal methodologies and scoring strategies to maximize evaluation outcomes

• Collaborate in real-time with graphic artists and SMEs to develop visually impactful slides that clearly convey technical solutions and win themes.

• Research and capture best practices from previous submissions, debriefs, and answers to follow-up questions

• Perform all other duties as assigned

Work Environment:

•
Location: Remote

•
Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%

•
Working Hours: Standard

Qualifications and Skills Requirements:

• Technical Degree plus 12+ years that includes 8 in industry and 4 in BD

• Experience developing oral proposals for FEDSIM and other large (>$200M) opportunities

• Strong project management skills including team facilitation and management of resources and schedules.

• Excellent communication/presentation skills including persuasive writing skills. Superior organization and follow-through skills. Strong interpersonal skills and analytical ability.

• Excellent business acumen. Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and adapt to changing priorities and assignments.

• Ability to lead and work together as a team, either in a support role or as a project leader

title: Sales Development Representative/Inside Sales Executive (f/m/d)
description:

- Full-time; unlimited -

As an Inside Sales Executive, you will play an important role in supporting our commercial growth by identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with prospective clients, and generating qualified sales opportunities for our Business Development team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their sales career who enjoys connecting with people, is motivated by results, and is eager to develop their commercial skills in an international environment.

• Collaborating closely with Business Development and Commercial teams to support sales objectives and territory growth.

• Experience working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.

title: Senior Product Designer (f/m/d)
CRO Strategist
description:
We need someone to own a portfolio of up to six brands end to end.
Find the test in the data and in what customers actually say, build the first version yourself, launch it, read the result, and tell the client what it means.
Tasks
One sentence: own the test loop end to end, from the research to the client.

Own CRO strategy and delivery for up to 6 brands, from the research through to the result.
Dig through the store data to find where each funnel is losing money.
Study competitors for offers, pages and mechanics worth testing.
Ship the first draft of the work, wether it's a full landing page or a copy test on an existing page hand it to our designer to polish and our developer to build.
Write the tasks our developers and designers build from clear enough that nobody has to guess what you meant.
Be the main point of contact for your clients. You are the person they talk to, not a layer between them and someone else.
Launch the tests, read the results, and tell the client what you ran, what it did, and what happens next.

Requirements
1-2 years of experience as a CRO strategist in a brand or agency.
Who You Are. Experience and background matter less than the following traits.
Bias to Action
You solve problems and move forward. You do not wait for permission, and you do not write a document about the problem instead of fixing it.
Makes the Team Win
We work as a team and win as a team. You make the people around you better on purpose, and you make the developer's and the designer's job easier without being asked. The result that counts is the one the team got to, not the one you got to alone.
Explains It So Anyone Gets It
You can explain the same test to a client or a team member, and both should come away able to act on it

This role will work closely with financial services clients to define business requirements, translate regulatory and compliance needs into functional solutions, and support the successful delivery of complex risk and compliance technology initiatives.
The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of experience as a Business Analyst , with strong expertise in financial crime, risk, and compliance domains , particularly AML, sanctions, transaction monitoring, fraud, or trade surveillance .

title: Software Engineer III - Weblogic JEE Developer
description:
What this Job Entails:
We are seeking a WebLogic / JEE Developer to be responsible for designing, developing, modifying, configuring, debugging, and evaluating WebLogic and Oracle Fusion integrations across key functional business areas.
Your primary focus will include delivering minor enhancements, resolving defect fixes on legacy WebLogic code, maintaining Oracle Service Bus (OSB) components, and supporting backend API calls. You will play a crucial role in stabilizing enterprise integration delivery projects and ensuring the high availability of critical utility integration channels.
Your Roles and Responsibilities:

• Integration Development & Maintenance: Develop new integrations and maintain existing WebLogic and Oracle Fusion / Oracle Service Bus (OSB) integrations.

• Legacy System Support: Execute minor enhancements, performance optimizations, and defect fixes on legacy WebLogic codebase and enterprise service bus layers.

• API Development & Support: Develop, extend, and maintain enterprise APIs; support backend API calls routed through WebLogic and Oracle Fusion middleware layers.

• Integration Patterns & Transformations: Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) patterns, including both Synchronous and Asynchronous message processing. Develop transformation logic using XQuery and XSLT.

• System Stabilization & Debugging: Support the stabilization of ongoing integration delivery projects by diagnosing message flow bottlenecks, system defects, and environment issues.

• Testing & Quality Assurance: Utilize SOAP UI and associated testing tools to perform end-to-end testing of SOAP/REST web services and integration endpoints.

• Environment Maintenance: Maintain and manage WebLogic Server 10g and/or 11g environments to ensure continuous uptime and seamless service orchestration

• Other duties as required. This list is not meant to be a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position

Required Qualifications/Skills:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience: 8+ years of enterprise experience in Java EE / JEE development and middleware integration platforms.

• WebLogic Mastery: Deep hands-on experience developing, configuring, maintaining, and managing WebLogic Server 10g / 11g .

• Oracle Service Bus (OSB) & Fusion: Proven experience building and maintaining integrations using Oracle Service Bus (OSB) and Oracle Fusion middleware suites.

• EAI Patterns & Transformations: Advanced knowledge of EAI patterns (Synchronous/Asynchronous) and extensive hands-on experience writing transformation logic in XQuery and XSLT .

• Testing & APIs: Demonstrated ability to build, debug, and test web services/APIs using SOAP UI .

Preferred Qualifications:

• Utility Industry Knowledge: Prior experience supporting enterprise integration teams in electric, gas, or critical infrastructure utilities.

• Legacy Modernization: Familiarity with migrating or bridging legacy JEE/WebLogic services to modern cloud-native or microservice architectures.

The AMER Support team is at the heart of that mission. Mironeers work in a hybrid model, with 2 days a week in our vibrant Austin hub as our baseline. We'd love the person in this role to be based in Austin and engaged in hub life, while staying flexible for the needs of a global team.

About the Role

As Manager, Customer Support AMER, you'll lead the regional team of Customer Support Representatives (Tier 2) and Technical Support Engineers (Tier 3) based primarily in Austin, and you'll oversee delivery of our Tier 1 outsourced support for AMER time zones. You'll be a core member of the Global Support Leadership team, reporting to the Global Head of Customer Support and working closely with peer managers across EMEA and JPAC, as well as our Support Excellence team (Programs, Enablement, and Operations). This is a role for someone who leads with empathy, runs toward hard problems, and takes pride in building high-performing, engaged teams.

What you’ll do

title: RBI Practitioners - EPC and Operational Phase

Intertek , Multinational Company leader in ATIC (Assurance, Testing, Inspection, Certifications) is seeking RBI Practitioners for upcoming work related to Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) phase of multiple Energy projects.
RBI Practitioners will support Corrosion Engineers and Inspection Engineers by performing the hands‑on execution work required to build, populate, and validate RBI models, inspection strategies, and integrity data structures. This role is essential for ensuring that EPC deliverables are complete, accurate, and aligned with approved RBI methodology and Client requirements.

• Identify and mark-up corrosion loops, circuits, CMLs, and inspection points directly on drawings and digital models.

• Support degradation mechanism assignment by reviewing process conditions, materials, and operating envelopes.

• Assist in developing inspection strategies, PoF/CoF inputs, and risk ranking outputs under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Perform data mining and data cleansing from EPC deliverables, vendor packages, and operational records.

• Upload, structure, and validate integrity data within RBI/IDMS platforms (Antea, Meridium/APM, Synergi, Credo, Aware, etc.).

• Support the preparation of RBI reports, inspection plans, and technical documentation for EPC reviews.

• Ensure all RBI work complies with Client standards, international codes, and project specifications.

• Coordinate with Corrosion, Mechanical and Inspection teams to resolve data gaps and ensure consistency across deliverables.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline. (Lack of Bachelor degree can be substituted with minimum 5 years of proven experience as RBI practitioner).

• Proven experience executing RBI studies within EPC or operational environments.

• Minimum 3 years combined experience (EPC + Operational) is mandatory, but 5+ years’ experience is preferred.

• Experience with RBI/IDMS platforms is essential (e.g., Antea, Meridium/APM, DNV Synergi, Credo, Intertek Aware).

• API 580 qualified or minimum 5 years proven experience in executing RBI Assessments.

• API 581 training is an advantage.

• AMPP/NACE certifications (Corrosion or CP) are beneficial but not essential.

• API 571 familiarity is preferred for degradation mechanism assignment

• Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, including PFDs, P&IDs, UFDs, and isometrics.

• Ability to extract, validate, and structure technical data for RBI models and IDMS platforms.

• Familiarity with degradation mechanisms, corrosion loops, CML strategies, and inspection planning principles.

• Working knowledge of CMMS hierarchy (SAP, Maximo, or equivalent) is beneficial.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

As a machine learning engineer in the Economics team, you will build state-of-the-art systems that blend rigorous economic thought with sophisticated machine learning algorithms to tackle some of the company's most challenging problems. Working in a horizontal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with partners across multiple functions to operate on a highly diverse set of problems, contributing both economic and engineering expertise in a fast-paced environment filled with exciting opportunities for technically-minded economists.

• An understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques.

• Strong programming skills (Python) and fluency in data manipulation (SQL, Pandas) and machine learning tools (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost).

• Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).

• Experience putting machine learning models into production environments.

• Experience with cloud computing and related ML infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

• A PhD in Economics or a closely related field with a focus on data-intense problems.

• Intern experience

title: Maritime Test Engineer - Autonomous Systems
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Maritime Test Engineer for Autonomous Systems, you will be on the front lines of proving our autonomous surface vehicles are ready for real-world deployment. This is a hands-on, on-the-water role: you will spend significant time aboard vessels executing test events, operating and monitoring autonomy systems, collecting data, and turning what you observe at sea into actionable findings for the engineering team. You will help bridge the gap between cutting-edge R&D and mission-proven capability, ensuring our systems are performant, reliable, and safe in the most demanding environments on Earth.

AT APPLIED, YOU WILL:

- Execute on-water test events for our fleet of autonomous surface vehicles, participating directly in sorties aboard test and chase vessels in closed-course and open-ocean environments

- Support pre-underway system checkouts, launch and recovery operations, and pier-side preparation of test vessels

- Operate and monitor autonomy systems during test events, executing test cards and procedures while maintaining situational awareness and safety on deck

- Collect, manage, and perform first-pass analysis of test data, ensuring data quality and completeness for each sortie

- Identify, document, and triage system discrepancies and anomalies using agile program management tooling such as Atlassian Jira, working closely with autonomy and hardware engineering teams

- Contribute to test plans, test procedures, and test readiness reviews under the direction of the Test & Evaluation Director

- Author clear, comprehensive after action reports and test reports that capture results, observations, and recommendations

- Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) and simulation-based testing between on-water events

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- Bachelor's Degree in a relevant engineering discipline (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Ocean, Systems), Computer Science, or a related technical field - or equivalent hands-on experience

title: Principal Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specializes in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.  

Position Summary

Reporting to the SHADOWLAB Senior Principal Systems Engineer, Electromagnetics and Cyber Group (EM&C), and supporting Metrea’s overall engineering efforts, the Principal Manufacturing Engineer will join our busy team specializing in state-of-the-art military communications and signals intelligence products. All our teams operate in a small agile environment which allows our engineering personnel to work independently on a wide variety of systems and products. Our mix of product development and R&D also provides our engineering staff with a constant flow of new and interesting projects.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer II to join the Engineering Experience domain in Vinted's Platform unit. Our domain builds the tools, platforms and golden paths that the rest of Vinted Engineering relies on every day - from the first line of code an engineer writes to the moment it runs safely in production.

Engineering Experience is made up of several teams, each owning a part of the engineering workflow:

CI/CD owns the flow from commit to production: code repository hosting and continuous integration, build artifacts and secrets, and deployment through ArgoCD - built and run in-house as self-service products for every engineering team.

Development Environments & AI is responsible for development environments and the engineering AI tooling ecosystem. Its flagship is Spinup, a cloud development environment that lets engineers and coding agents validate changes in remote environments without the complexity of managing local services. The team also leads the adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the company.

DevPortal builds Vinted's internal developer portal - the service catalog and self-service workflows that give every team clear ownership and one place to provision and operate their services.

Quality Engineering delivers tooling and processes for effective quality assurance across Vinted, from test infrastructure to reporting and quality metrics.

You'll join one of these teams - Development Environments & AI or CI/CD. You'll report to your team's Engineering Manager and collaborate closely with the other Engineering Experience teams. As a member of this domain, you will suggest, design and implement solutions for fast and reliable development, integration, delivery and quality, and ensure their successful adoption across the organisation.

In this position, you’ll 

• Explore, adopt and enable AI-assisted approaches for your own delivery and to improve the efficiency and quality of others across Vinted's software development life cycle

• Design, build and own tools, services and frameworks that make development, delivery and quality fast and reliable, using technologies such as Go, Ruby and Kubernetes

• See your output used by hundreds of other engineers across Vinted

• Make Vinted's codebase work well with coding agents - the context, conventions and scaffolding that raise the quality of AI-generated code

• Build tooling and introduce processes to handle complex problems, such as growing pull request review load, AI assisted PR-merge

Coder is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own Workflows and Integrations, two of the newest surfaces in Coder Agents. You'll take charters that are close to a blank page and give them a strategy.

Workflows is the automation layer for the AI software development lifecycle. It owns how the development work a team repeats every day becomes something agents run for them, and how our users author, reuse, and share those automations.

Integrations is the connective tissue that lets our agents reach outward and outside tools reach in. First-party product integrations such as Slack and Linear, connectors to the external tools our customers already run, and the API and auth work that makes each of those feel like a first-class part of the product.

You'll define vision and strategy where it's still nascent, then bring enough structure to scale without slowing momentum. What you'll do here

- Own the full product lifecycle for Workflows and Integrations, from incubating ideas through GA and into ongoing scale, including the sequencing between the two.

- Define and evolve product vision and strategy for both charters, synthesizing customer, market, and business signals into a clear roadmap.

- Define what development work is worth automating first, and what it takes for a team to trust an agent to run it unattended.

- Own the integration surface as a product: which third-party tools our agents can reach, and what partners need to build against us.

- Research customer problems through direct engagement with enterprise accounts, community feedback, and ecosystem analysis.

- Bring just enough structure to move fast without losing rigor: strong problem statements, crisp requirements, clear execution.

- Lead high-stakes customer conversations, including executive roadmap reviews, product demos, and enterprise stakeholder discussions.

- You've owned a platform, API, or extensibility surface that other people built on top of, and you understand the versioning, auth, and governance trade-offs that come with it.

- Proven experience taking a product from zero to GA, setting direction where little exists yet.

- Experience shipping into enterprise engineering organisations, where the adopter is a developer and the buyer is a platform or engineering leader.

- A strong technical foundation that lets you collaborate credibly with engineers and make informed trade-offs.

- Proven ability to operate independently and set the agenda with minimal oversight.

- Willingness to travel occasionally for customer and industry engagements.

title: Program Manager Aircraft Integrations
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

In this role, you will lead and integrate ISR aircraft modification and capability delivery programs across multiple projects, teams, and stakeholders. You will provide program-level leadership to Integration Project Managers, ensuring aligned execution across cost, schedule, and technical performance while maintaining a clear focus on operational effect. You will be successful if you can translate ISR mission needs into executable programs, drive disciplined delivery across a portfolio of aircraft integrations, and consistently deliver capability to customers on time, quality, and budget.

What You'll Do

• Lead and manage ISR aircraft modification and integration programs across multiple concurrent projects.

• Directly oversee and mentor Integration Project Managers, ensuring consistent standards and delivery outcomes.

• Own program-level cost, schedule, and performance, including forecasting, reporting, and risk management.

• Translate customer ISR mission requirements into executable program plans.

• Coordinate across engineering, production, certification, and operations.

• Manage program interfaces with customers, partners, and stakeholders.

• Drive integration of mission systems, sensors, and communications capabilities.

• Improve program management processes and governance.

• Oversee supplier and subcontractor performance.

• Lead program reviews and senior stakeholder reporting.

What You Bring

• 8+ years of experience in ISR, special mission aircraft, or aerospace integration.

• Experience leading multi-project programs and managing project managers.

• Background in aircraft modification and mission system integration.

• Proven delivery of programs to cost, schedule, and performance targets.

• Experience managing budgets and forecasting.

• Strong stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to operate strategically and tactically.

• Experience with ISR sensors, communications systems, or data architectures.

• Familiarity with certification processes (e.g., Part 21).

• Experience in defense or government environments.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Aviation Management, Project Management, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

• PMP or equivalent

• Microsoft Project certifications

• Proficient in Microsof

title: Product Security Engineer, North Security
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

WHY THIS ROLE

Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can't afford to get wrong. Securing that means working on problems the industry hasn't settled yet, what authorization means when an agent acts on a user's behalf, how to contain tools that consume untrusted input, and whether tenant boundaries hold when a model can be steered by the data it reads. The established playbooks only take you so far.

We're hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work these problems alongside the engineers building the products, reviewing architecture and code, threat modeling before implementation, testing what ships, and turning what you learn into defaults other teams inherit. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead security reviews. Review architecture, code, and security-sensitive changes. Identify both individual vulnerabilities and the recurring design patterns behind them.

- Secure AI-powered products. Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, identity and delegation failures, excessive agency, data exposure, tenant isolation, and sandbox escapes.

- Threat model new capabilities. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and high-impact failure modes before implementation. Translate findings into practical, prioritized mitigations.

- Perform hands-on testing. Investigate suspected vulnerabilities, develop proofs of concept, assess exploitability and impact, and partner with engineers through remediation.

- Build scalable guardrails. Develop secure defaults, approved patterns, reusable controls, review requirements, and automated checks that reduce recurring risks.

- Strengthen engineering capability. Pair with engineers, document practical guidance, and help product teams develop durable security expertise.

- Influence risk decisions. Explain technical findings, business impact, and remediation options clearly to engineers, product leaders, and executives.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF

- You have strong software engineering fundamentals and can independently understand, test, and contribute fixes to production codebases.

- You are proficient in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript.

- You have led security reviews or threat models for complex production systems and can point to meaningful design or risk improvements that resulted.

- You understand common vulnerability classes and their underlying design failures, including injection, authorization flaws, IDOR, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, race conditions, cryptographic misuse, and software supply-chain risks.

- You understand modern application architecture, including web applications, APIs, OAuth/OIDC, cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD systems.

- You can reason rigorously about untrusted input, authorization, isolation, identity, delegation, and data boundaries. Direct experience with agentic AI systems is valuable but not required.
